question: What is the inspiration behind Kokoro Letters?
answer: Kokoro Letters is a passion project born from a deep love for Japan and its scenic wonders. Over the course of 12 months, we explore 12 handpicked regions across Japan that inspired iconic Studio Ghibli movies. Every single item we send is thoughtfully handmade, hand-printed, and curated to bring that cinematic peace directly into your hands.

question: What will I receive in my physical mailbox each month?
answer: Each month, you will receive a beautifully prepared envelope containing: 1) A hand-printed art print of a scenic movie scene inspired by that month's region; 2) A custom-designed sticker inspired by that specific anime; 3) A high-quality region sticker; and 4) A detailed, heartfelt letter from me describing the region, the anime it inspired, and the story of how it was built. Nothing more, nothing less—just pure, tactile Ghibli magic.

question: How does the physical Japan Map work?
answer: When you subscribe, your very first month's shipment includes a premium physical map of Japan with all 12 featured Ghibli-inspired regions marked. Each month, as your new parcel arrives, you can place the included region sticker onto its corresponding spot on the map, slowly completing your own beautiful visual travel journal over the year!

question: Are the letters and prints truly handmade?
answer: Yes, absolutely! Everything in our envelopes is handmade, hand-printed, and packaged with care. We use heavy, textured paper and artisanal printing techniques to preserve a rustic, warm, and authentic feel that digital printing simply cannot match.

question: When do letters ship and how long does delivery take?
answer: Our handcrafted envelopes are sealed and dispatched during the first week of every month. For domestic India delivery, letters usually arrive in 7-10 business days. For International delivery, shipping takes 8-14 business days depending on local postal services.

question: Can I pause or cancel my subscription?
answer: Of course. You are in complete control. You can pause, skip a month, or cancel your subscription at any time directly through your Personal Travel Ledger with a single click, or by reaching out to our friendly support email.
